cases.title: US001-02_01_Block_mode_dialing_8262_SIP
cases.custom_description:
A) Objective :

The aim of this test is to check the user story :
US001-02 - As a user, I want to be able to dial a number in block mode or
in overlap mode.

The aim of this test is to check that a call can be made in block mode dialing.
Numbers are dialed locally and sent to the call server upon off hook key  

Select on the system the required codec used for the base:
\- G711 (law a or ?)
\- G729 (A or AB)  

Note : Only one codec G726 is used in the DECT mobile ; it is not modifiable.  

B) Equipment and system configuration

\- 1 System (Rainbow office, Rainbow hub, OXE or OXO)
\- 1 Base station : DECT Base Station (any kind of base station)
\- 1 DECT mobile : 8214 DECT = DUT (Device Under Test)
\- 1 DECT charger

custom_steps_separated.content:
Start dialing without off-hooking then press "green" key

\- use the different audio modes to talk to the distant set (handset and handsfree)
\- set the volume level in each audio mode
\- release the call by "on-hook"
In CAT IQ mode the pressing on the OK key gives the possibility to save the dialed number to the local directory.

The user must press the off hook key to lauch the number dialed in block mode.
custom_steps_separated.expected:
\- be carefull about the tons (dial, routing, alerting ...)
-a bi directionnal call
-a good audio quality
-no perturbation can be heard during the transition phases between two audio modes
-volume level changes are operating
-the display is good
-the communication has been released

custom_steps_separated.content:
Start dialing without off-hooking then press "green" key
(For CatIq mode on OXO system this action should be:Start dialing without off-hooking then press "off-hooking button")  

Release the communication by on-hook during the distant set is ringing.
custom_steps_separated.expected:
-the call has been released
-the set is available again when you off-hook

custom_steps_separated.content:
Start dialing without off-hooking then press "green" key  

Release the communication by on-hook before the distant set rings.
custom_steps_separated.expected:
-the call has been released
-the set is available again when you off-hook

cases.title: US002-02_01_Calling_Line_Identification_Presentation_CLIP_8262_SIP
cases.custom_description:
A) Objective :

The aim of this test is to check the user story :
US002-02 -As a user, I want to be able to see the calling number if the name is not available during ringing phase and conversation.

Select on the system the required codec used for the base :
\- G711 (law a or ?)
\- G729 (A or AB)  

Note : Only one codec G726 is used in the DECT mobile ; it is not modifiable.

_
_

remind :
Calling Line Identification Presentation ( CLIP ) A == > calls B
=> identification of caller ( A ) displayed on called (B)  

Calling Line Identification Restriction ( CLIR ) A == > calls B
=> no identification of caller ( A ) displayed on called (B)  

Connected Line Identification Presentation ( COLP ) A == > calls B
=> identification of called ( B ) displayed on caller (A)  

Connected Line Identification Restriction ( COLR ) A == > calls B
=> no identification of called ( B ) displayed on caller (A)
remarks :

  • the CLIP/CLIR is a user feature,
  • the COLP/COLR is a PABX feature.

B) Equipment and system configuration

\- 1 System (Rainbow office, Rainbow hub, OXE or OXO)
\- 1 Base station : DECT Base Station (any kind of base station)
\- 1 DECT mobile : 8214 DECT = DUT (Device Under Test)
\- 1 DECT charger

custom_steps_separated.content:
Phone B activated CLIP
Initiate an incoming call from a distant phone " B " to the device under test " A " .
The number of the phone " B " is not present in any contact list of the DUT " A ".
Watch the call presentation on the screen of the DUT during the ringing phase.
custom_steps_separated.expected:
Number of the phone " B " is displayed on the DUT " A " during the ringing .

(OXE/OXO internal calls : B's Displayed Name )

custom_steps_separated.content:
Initiate an incoming call from a distant phone " B " to the device under test " A " .
The number of the phone " B " is not present in any contact list of the DUT " A ".

DUT takes the incoming call.
Watch the call presentation on the screen of the DUT during the ringing phase and after in conversation state.
custom_steps_separated.expected:
Number of the phone " B " is displayed on the DUT " A " during the conversation.

(OXE/OXO internal calls : B's Displayed Name )
